_note: Raw serving-environment facts captured during the japaneast A100 (Spot) vLLM benchmark run. These are measurements (not derived): 'engine' is the live-imported package/GPU stack at serving time; 'weight_vram_gib' is vLLM's clean serving-only weight VRAM parsed from its 'Model loading took X GiB' log at load (W5). v2_report.py consumes this together with the read-only bench_*.json sweeps/latencies to regenerate results/vllm_throughput.json; it is a read-only historical input and must not be hand-edited.
